They're just sending the whole net at us now?|[[Clive]] on Wave 15 ([[Competition Court]])|audio = AdidasMission2Wave15-1.ogg}} }} ==Description== The '''Soccer Goal''' was an enemy from the [[Backyard Legends Event]] and the final boss of the [[Competition Court]] map. It had high health but it walked quite slowly. It had one ability where it would summon in eight [[Soccer Head]]s, with each one spawning 0.3 seconds after another. ==Appearance== The '''Soccer Goal''' looks like your typical white soccer net that has grass on the bottom. It also has black arms with white gloves and black legs with black and white shoes. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Militant]] and [[Trapper]] can be quite effective at taking this out. **The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} SoccerGoalCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} AdidasMission2EasyRender.png|'''Soccer Goal''' on the matchmaking icon. AdidasMission2HardRender.png|'''Soccer Goal''' on the matchmaking icon. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SoccerGoalIconIG.png|'''Soccer Goal''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Soccer Goal''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Soccer Goal''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Soccer Goal's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. **{{Bug}} '''Soccer Goal''' can get stuck if it performs its ''Summon'' ability on a bear trap from the [[Trapper]]. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Soccer Goal''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{CompetitionCourt|[[Decoy]]|Wave 13|Soccer Goal|Wave 15|End|N/A}} {{VictoryField|[[Decoy]]|Wave 13|Soccer Goal|Wave 14|[[Goal Keeper]]|Wave 17}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
